title: Lesion-Aware Explainable AI for Diabetic Retinopathy Grading from Fundus Images
abstract: arXiv:2611.19550v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Post-hoc explanations of deep-learning models for diabetic retinopathy (DR) grading are difficult to trust because different attribution methods highlight different retinal regions for the same image, and a visually plausible heatmap does not show that the highlighted pixels drive the prediction. We propose the Consensus-Calibrated Explanation Map (CCEM), which fuses Grad-CAM++, Ada-SISE, and SmoothGrad Integrated Gradients (SG-IG) using image-specific weights derived from annotation-free reliability cues: deletion sensitivity, inter-method agreement, compactness, retinal containment, and peak structure. CCEM explains a frozen ordinal grader, an EfficientNet-B7 with CBAM and a scalar regression head, pre-trained on EyePACS 2015 in Stage 1 and fine-tuned on APTOS 2019 in Stage 2 with quadratic weighted kappa (QWK)-optimized thresholds; it reaches a QWK of 0.920 on the hidden Kaggle test set and 0.559 on the external MAPLES-DR cohort. translated_title: 面向眼底图像糖尿病视网膜病变分级的病灶感知可解释人工智能
translated_abstract: 深度学习模型用于糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）分级的事后解释难以令人信服，因为针对同一张图像，不同的归因方法会高亮不同的视网膜区域，而且视觉上看似合理的热图并不能证明被高亮的像素真正驱动了预测。我们提出了一致性校准解释图（CCEM），它融合了Grad-CAM++、Ada-SISE和SmoothGrad积分梯度（SG-IG），并使用从无需标注的可靠性线索中导出的图像特定权重进行加权，这些线索包括：删除敏感性、方法间一致性、紧凑性、视网膜包含性和峰值结构。CCEM用于解释一个冻结的序数分级器——一个带有CBAM模块和标量回归头的EfficientNet-B7，该模型在第一阶段于EyePACS 2015上预训练，在第二阶段于APTOS 2019上使用二次加权Kappa（QWK）优化的阈值进行微调；该模型在隐藏的Kaggle测试集上达到了0.920的QWK，在外部MAPLES-DR队列上达到了0.559。
tldr: 提出一致性校准解释图（CCEM），通过融合多种归因方法并基于无需标注的可靠性线索进行图像自适应加权，为糖尿病视网膜病变分级模型提供更可信的可解释性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes the Consensus-Calibrated Explanation Map (CCEM), which fuses multiple attribution methods with image-specific weights derived from annotation-free reliability cues to deliver trustworthy explainable AI for diabetic retinopathy grading.
